overview: Roadie Roster is an opening-week staffing app for a retail store: it hires and tracks roadies, manages schedules, uniforms, crews, leaders and orientation, and now assigns roadies to trainers on per-shift training group boards.
features: Per-shift training group boards assigning roadies to trainers
Drag-and-drop board on laptop and iPad with a phone list view
Shift picker across Training Days 1-4 and Friends & Family nights
Copy from another shift, make groups automatically, and clear a board
Warnings for unassigned roadies, over-capacity trainers and unavailable roadies
Group-change notices for trainers on Today and Groups
Trainer My group view on Today
